en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Dawood Bin Sirhan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The witnesses should not refuse to answer when they are summoned before the writing (documenting)’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Dawud ibn Sarhan who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Witnesses must not refuse to present their testimony when they are called before it (the case and testimony) is written down.’”
